home.eyebrow: Belluzzi Open Tools · free and open
home.title: Useful tools.
home.description: A collection of fast, accessible and transparent utilities for real tasks — no signup, tracking or third-party ads.
home.principle_local_text: Whenever possible, everything happens on your device.
home.principle_open_text: Inspect it, contribute or host it on your own infrastructure.
home.principle_simple_text: No signup and no turning a simple task into a sales funnel.
home.tools_description: We start with the essentials. New utilities arrive when they solve a problem clearly.
home.qr_description: Create QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contacts, events, WhatsApp, email and text. Export PNG or SVG.
home.pass_description: Secure passwords and passphrases generated entirely in your browser.
home.utm_description: Build campaign and WhatsApp links without improvised spreadsheets.
home.data_description: Format and convert JSON, YAML and CSV without uploading your files.
home.manifesto_text: Belluzzi maintains these tools as real public software: useful on the official instance, easy to self-host and built with the same care applied to client products.

footer.description: Free and open source tools created by Heron Belluzzi.

pass.meta_description: Generate strong passwords and passphrases in your browser with Web Crypto. Free, open source and without sending or storing your data.
pass.eyebrow: Pass · local generation with Web Crypto
pass.title: A strong password. Yours alone.
pass.description: Set the rules and generate a password or passphrase with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is sent or stored.

options.capitalize: Start words with an uppercase letter

pass.result_hint: Use a different password for every service.
pass.privacy_note: Generation uses Web Crypto in your browser. The password is not sent over the network, saved by the site or included in the page address.
pass.entropy_note: Entropy is a mathematical estimate that assumes uniform, independent choices. It cannot guarantee security after the password is copied or shared.
pass.security_note: Never reuse passwords. Store them in a trusted password manager and enable two-factor authentication whenever available.

errors.unavailable: A secret could not be generated. Make sure your browser supports Web Crypto.
errors.copy: Automatic copying failed. Select the result and copy it manually.

utm.meta_description: Create campaign links with consistent UTMs and official WhatsApp links. Free, open source and processed in your browser.
utm.title: Links ready to measure and share.
utm.description: Build campaigns and conversations without improvised spreadsheets. Validate, copy or turn the result into a QR code without sending data to the server.

fields.phone: Phone with country and area code
fields.message_placeholder: Hello! I would like to learn more about the project.

utm.phone_notice: Validation confirms the international format only, not whether the number exists or who owns it.

result_hint.utm: Existing parameters and the URL fragment are preserved.
result_hint.whatsapp: The message is encoded to open correctly in WhatsApp.

utm.result_empty: Complete the required fields to generate a link.
utm.long_url_warning: This URL exceeds 2,000 characters and may not work in some channels.
utm.privacy_note: Generation, validation and preview are local. We do not save the URL, phone number or message.

guidance.utm: Use consistent names across campaigns. Source identifies the platform, medium identifies the channel and campaign identifies the initiative.
guidance.whatsapp: Enter the full number including country code. Review the message before publishing the link.

utm.qr_handoff_note: When you choose Generate QR, the link is transferred once to QR Studio and removed from session storage.

data.meta_title: JSON, YAML and CSV formatter and converter
data.meta_description: Format, validate and convert JSON, YAML and CSV locally in your browser. Free, open source and without uploading your data.
data.title: Structured data, without the friction.
data.description: Format, validate, convert and preview JSON, YAML or CSV. Your content and files stay in this browser.
data.input_hint: Paste text or choose a local file.
data.output_empty: Choose an operation and process the input.
data.output_placeholder: The processed result will appear here.
data.preview_hint: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}. The preview displays up to 20 rows and 12 columns.
data.privacy_title: Your data stays on this device
data.privacy_note: Parsing, conversion, preview, copying and downloads run in your browser. The tool does not upload or store the input.
data.safety_note: Inputs are limited to 1 MB. YAML aliases and executable custom tags are not accepted, reducing the risk of resource abuse or unsafe parsing.
